about: Preview for two stronger-performance 数字人 takes after c7 (user: 「人物表演还差点」). Same inputs as OH-A/OH-B; the action text targets the gate findings: eyes down at the start, a static mouth mid phrase 2, identity drift when the head turns frontal. Nothing is submitted before the user approves.

audio.role: uploaded vocal (isolated), not TTS or a cloned voice; chorus pass 1 'I didn't run / I just looked outside'

mode: 即梦 数字人 · 大师模式 · 1080P · single subject (not 生动模式, which crops to 1:1)

OH-C.action_prompt: 镜头固定特写，保持原图的构图和头部角度。她从第一个字起就抬眼直视镜头，投入地唱，每个字嘴唇都清楚地张合，乐句之间轻轻换气，肩膀随呼吸微微起伏；第一句结尾眉眼微微用力，最后一句眼神变柔，嘴角带一点笑意。
OH-C.why: eyes on the lens from the first word; every word moves the mouth; keep the original head angle; a slight smile at the end (the user liked S7's)

OH-D.action_prompt: 镜头固定特写，保持原图的构图和头部角度。她闭着眼轻声唱起，第一句唱到一半睁开眼直视镜头，情绪越来越饱满，每个字嘴唇都清楚地张合，乐句之间深深吸一口气，肩膀随之起伏，最后一句唱得温柔而坚定，嘴角带一点笑意。
OH-D.why: eyes closed at first, open to the lens mid phrase 1, building; deeper breaths; same angle and mouth rules

budget.note: OH-A/OH-B were 30 each; stop and ask if the page shows more than 60
